# Content formats

Regia Engine's content formats are **frozen**: a format's serde shape may only change together with a version bump and a registered migrator, and `cargo xtask check-formats` fails the merge gate otherwise (see [Changing a content format](../changing-a-content-format.md)). Every loader accepts every older version and upgrades it in memory. `regia upgrade-project --write` rewrites the files of every format with a registered migrator (material, level, prefab, terrain-layer, scatter, UI, theme, VFX and the others in the table below) and cooked meshes in the dev cache on disk (keeping a `.bak` of each original).
